lines.zh: 二十格宽的身影移过来
lines.en: A shape twenty blocks wide moves toward you.
The ground shudders beneath my tread.
My tendrils drag behind, carving furrows.

lines.zh: 移动速度不快，却压得人喘不过气
lines.en: Not fast, but it crushes the air from you.
My bulk shoulders the trees aside.
Every shift raises a gust.
Puddles dry where I pass.
My shell advances segment by segment.
My shadow covers the whole slope.
Birds scatter in a panic far off.
This vast body comes to rest.
Light seeps from the seams of my shell.

lines.zh: 二十四点护甲，动都不动
lines.en: Twenty-four points of armor, utterly still.
My tendrils sway slowly around me.
I am like a living island.
The air thickens around me.
A deep pulse beats inside me.
Something flows within my body.
I look toward the horizon.
This land is too thin to hold me.

lines.zh: 二十格的身躯，压平一片林。
lines.en: A twenty-block body has flattened a whole grove.
And I'm still in no hurry.
Barnacles crust my shell.
Grass withers at my feet.
I lift my head a little.
Mist gathers in the distance.

lines.zh: 你连我一个指节都不到
lines.en: You don't reach one knuckle of mine.
I bend down to look at you.
My eye blinks only rarely.
You stand there, very small.
I know the ones who were chosen.

lines.zh: 你抬头，还看不到我的顶。
lines.en: Look up and you still can't see the top of me.
This place should be sea.
You carry an odd smell.
I lean down to look at you, a grain of sand
That much, and the light dims.
You didn't run. Now I'm interested.
I let out a very low resonance.
This pain arrives from very far away.
I look down. It's nothing.
Your attacks fall like raindrops.
I feel them. I don't care.
A hairline crack opens in my shell.
I lower my head for the first time.

lines.zh: 这点伤，连鳞片都没划开。
lines.en: That scratch didn't even split a scale.

lines.zh: 我体内的东西翻搅了一下
lines.en: Something inside me churns.
My resonance deepens.
You're worth another look.

lines.zh: 那点东西，塞不住我的缝
lines.en: That wouldn't fill one seam of mine.
Still, it smells decent.
I lower my head to sniff by your hand.

lines.zh: 陆地生物的吃法我不懂
lines.en: I don't understand how land things eat.
Flesh is flesh. I'll take it.

lines.zh: 我的进食量你想象不到
lines.en: You can't imagine how much I eat.
This isn't even an appetizer.
But I'll remember the gesture.
It smells like something alive.
A tendril reaches out to touch it.
You struck me and I felt nothing.
My shell is harder than rock.
You'd push twenty blocks of me?
You're flung a good distance back.
That barely reached me.
Half a step, and the ground splits.
Don't stand under my shadow.
Your bones held. Lucky.
Get back. I dislike being brushed.
The wind off me pushes you back.
My kind wait for me in the deep.
This land is too small.

lines.zh: 等海漫过来，才会有同族
lines.en: When the sea arrives, my kind will come.
I send a long call. No answer.
O chosen one.

lines.zh: 你和我之间，隔着整片海
lines.en: An entire sea lies between us.

lines.zh: 我把触须伸向远方的雾
lines.en: I reach a tendril toward the mist.
That is where I belong.
The land is only the road.
The end is a sea.
A tendril lifts it without effort.
Brought to my mouth. Far too small.
My jaws close from both sides.
Crumbs fall between my plates.
Not enough. Nowhere near.
I press it into a seam for later.
The taste is very faint.

lines.zh: 我咽下时地面震了一下
lines.en: The ground jolts as I swallow.
A tendril reaches out again.
I'm far from full.
This time it's you.
You took that step closer.
My eye locks onto you.
Thirty blocks is enough for me to turn.
The ground begins to sink.
The pressure bows your head.
No cry. Only approach.
You hear a very low vibration.
That is my breathing.
My domain is spreading.

lines.zh: 这一片很快就不一样了
lines.en: This patch will change very soon.
I extend one tendril toward you.
This isn't a threat. It's notice.
The sea is coming.
You're simply first.
Consider it an honor.
You have stepped into my shadow.
Make way for the sea.
I turn this body, slowly.
One turn takes a long while.
You don't have that long.
Tendrils settle around you.
Each thicker than a tree.
I seal the way, segment by segment.

lines.zh: 六五九三的伤害，一次就够
lines.en: Six thousand damage. Once is enough.
Your blows land like rain on me.
I feel them. They don't matter.
The mist deepens.
The air is thick with salt.
Water has covered your retreat.
I move, and the whole land moves.
Not one firm patch under your feet.
I raise my forelimb.
My shadow reaches you first.
Then the weight.
Don't look up now.
It wouldn't help to look.
The last moment.
My forelimb falls and the ground caves.
That blow flattens a tree to splinters.
A tendril whips past your side.

lines.zh: 六五九三的伤害，你承受不住
lines.en: Six thousand damage. You can't take it.

lines.zh: 我把它挥开，像挥开一只虫
lines.en: I sweep it aside like an insect.

lines.zh: 这一下没打中，只是擦到
lines.en: Not a hit. Only a graze.
Your armor becomes debris.
Wind first, impact after.
Water jets from the cracks.
I lower my bulk to pin you down.
One step down and the ground becomes a crater.
I let you linger a moment.
None remains now.
After this blow, the sea arrives.
A silhouette forms in the mist.
Twenty blocks of body bear down.
The earth dents into a deep basin.
The air turns thick all at once.
The smell of salt rushes in.
I open my eye. The light is dim.
The grass around me begins to wither.
Water seeps from my shell's seams.
I raise this body, slowly.

lines.zh: 天空被我的影子切了一半
lines.en: My shadow splits the sky in half.

lines.zh: 我来自比海更深的地方
lines.en: I come from deeper than the sea.
The chosen one is near.
I can smell that particular scent.

lines.zh: 大地在颤抖，不是我造成的
lines.en: The earth trembles, and not from me.
Or perhaps it is.
I give my first long call.
The distant sea answers.
This land begins to sink.
Starting here.
Starting this very moment.
Fire on my shell is a candle wick.

lines.zh: 落地时压碎了自己脚下的地
lines.en: I land and crush the ground I stand on.

lines.zh: 水是我的家，但这里太浅
lines.en: Water is home, but this is too shallow.
The blast raises dust and nothing more.
It stopped the moment it met me.

lines.zh: 这一招刺进了壳的深处
lines.en: This one pierced deep into my shell.

lines.zh: 太久没进食，我变得迟钝
lines.en: Long unfed, I've grown sluggish.
Lightning spreads across my shell.
Even I begin to sink.
